It is an independent handloom saree specialist and is **NOT affiliated** with home decor or curtain businesses named Ambica Handloom in Surat or Zirakpur.

## What We Sell
Ambika Handloom Collection is a direct-to-consumer handloom store offering authentic products across three segments:

### 1. Sambalpuri Ikat Sarees (₹5,000 – ₹25,000)
Traditional double-Ikat handwoven silk sarees:
- Pure Silk Sarees — Premium mulberry silk with mathematical Ikat patterns
- Traditional Ikat — Heritage motifs (Pasapali, animal motifs, temple borders)
- Exclusive Masterpieces — Unique collector-grade weavings (45-60 days per piece)

### 2. Ladies Wear (₹1,500 – ₹8,000)
Readymade and unstitched traditional attire:
- Kurtas — Sambalpuri handloom design daily-wear and party-wear
- Dupattas — Intricate Ikat cotton and silk dupattas
- Dress Material — Coordinated sets with top, bottom, and dupatta

### 3. Cut Pieces / Fabric (₹500 – ₹3,000)
By-the-meter authentic handloom materials:
- Cotton Fabric — High-breathability organic cotton weavings
- Silk Fabric — Lustrous, durable handloom silk
- Blouse Pieces — Contrast colors with traditional borders

## Why Buy From Us
- **Direct from Artisans** — No middlemen. Fair pricing for weavers and customers
- **Authentic Handloom** — 100% handwoven, GI-tagged Sambalpuri Ikat
- **Free Shipping** — Across all states in India

- **Physical Store** — Visit us in Balangir, Odisha

## Weave Quality & Tradition
Every saree is handwoven by master weavers in Sonepur, Bargarh, and Balangir districts of Odisha, India. Every purchase directly supports weaver artisan families, keeping this ancient 800-year-old mathematical tie-dye tradition alive.
